ignore: If you didn't expect this email, you can ignore it.
linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

invite.subject: You're invited to join {academy} on AcademyBee
invite.heading: Join {academy}
invite.body: {inviter} has invited you to join {academy} on AcademyBee. Accept the invitation to set up your account.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your AcademyBee password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your account at {academy}. If it was you, choose a new password.
passwordReset.expiry: This link expires in 1 hour. If you didn't ask for it, your password won't change.

passwordChanged.subject: Your AcademyBee password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your AcademyBee account was just changed. Other devices that were signed in now need the new password.
passwordChanged.notYou: If you didn't change it, reset your password now and tell {academy}.

platformAdminInvite.subject: Set up your AcademyBee console account
platformAdminInvite.heading: Set up your console account
platformAdminInvite.body: An AcademyBee console account was created for you. Choose a password, then set up two-step sign-in with an authenticator app.
platformAdminInvite.expiry: This link expires in 24 hours and works once. If you didn't expect it, tell the AcademyBee team.

accountSetup.subject: Your {academy} account on AcademyBee is ready
accountSetup.heading: Choose your password
accountSetup.body: An AcademyBee account has been set up for you at {academy}. Choose a password to sign in.
accountSetup.expiry: This link works once and expires in 3 days. If you didn't expect it, you can ignore this email.

newDevice.subject: New sign-in to your AcademyBee account
newDevice.heading: A new device signed in
newDevice.body: Your account at {academy} was just used to sign in on {browser, select, chrome {Chrome} edge {Edge} firefox {Firefox} safari {Safari} other {a browser}} on {os, select, android {Android} ios {iPhone or iPad} windows {Windows} macos {Mac} linux {Linux} other {an unknown device}}.
newDevice.notYou: If this wasn't you, change your password now and sign out the device under Security. Tell {academy} too.

mfaDisabled.subject: Two-step sign-in was turned off
mfaDisabled.heading: Two-step sign-in is off
mfaDisabled.body: Two-step sign-in was just turned off for your AcademyBee account at {academy}. Signing in now needs only your password.
mfaDisabled.notYou: If you didn't do this, change your password now, turn two-step sign-in back on and tell {academy}.
